name: DGNR (Density-Guided Neural Point Rendering)
definition: A neural point rendering method for large driving scenes that uses a density space P and camera parameters C to learn neural density features τ and network parameters θ, utilizing density-guided fusion and differentiable rendering to complete density points.
summary: DGNR is a neural point rendering framework that learns a 3D density space from images to guide point placement, eliminating the need for LiDAR or geometric priors.
